_note: Approximate stage windows in days after sowing (DAS). They vary by variety, season and weather. Validate against ANGRAU / local KVK package-of-practices before real use. No fertilizer doses or pesticide rates are given on purpose.

activities: Check stand establishment and note gaps
Keep the field free of early weeds
stages.irrigation: Maintain adequate moisture for germination; avoid waterlogging.
stages.nutrients: Follow the soil-test-based basal plan decided before sowing.
stages.monitoring: Look for seedling mortality, soil-borne rots and early sucking pests.

activities: Scout leaves for spots and leaf miner damage
stages.irrigation: Light, timely irrigation if rain is lacking; avoid stress and standing water.
stages.nutrients: Consult the local agriculture officer on any top-dressing.
stages.monitoring: Scout weekly for leaf spots, leaf miner and thrips.

activities: Earthing up so pegs reach the soil
Avoid disturbing the crop once pegging starts
stages.irrigation: Flowering and pegging are moisture-sensitive; avoid water stress.
stages.nutrients: Calcium and sulphur needs are soil dependent; ask your KVK.
stages.monitoring: Watch for leaf spot, rust and defoliators.

activities: Check pod filling by sampling plants
stages.irrigation: Keep moisture even; avoid long dry spells and waterlogging.
stages.nutrients: No fixed advice here; follow soil-test guidance.
stages.monitoring: Check for pod rot, white grub and foliar disease.

activities: Sample pods for maturity before lifting
Plan drying and safe storage to limit aflatoxin risk
stages.irrigation: Reduce irrigation near maturity as advised locally.
stages.monitoring: Check pod maturity markers; harvest at the right time.

stages.irrigation: Light irrigation for establishment; avoid waterlogging.
stages.monitoring: Watch for sucking pests (jassids, aphids, thrips).

activities: Scout for pests twice a week
stages.irrigation: Irrigate according to soil moisture and rainfall.
stages.nutrients: Ask the local agriculture officer about top-dressing timing.
stages.monitoring: Scout for sucking pests and early bollworm eggs.

activities: Continue scouting for pests and nutrient deficiency
Remove badly infested plant parts if advised
stages.irrigation: Flowering is moisture-sensitive; avoid stress.
stages.nutrients: Consult experts; do not guess doses.
stages.monitoring: Watch for bollworm, whitefly and leaf curl symptoms.

stages.irrigation: Maintain moisture; avoid waterlogging.
stages.monitoring: Check bolls for bollworm damage and boll rot.

stages.irrigation: Reduce irrigation as bolls open.
stages.monitoring: Avoid trash and moisture in picked cotton.

activities: Check seedlings for pests and disease
stages.irrigation: Keep the nursery moist, with shallow water as seedlings grow.
stages.monitoring: Watch seedlings for blast and stem borer signs.

activities: Gap filling after a few days
stages.irrigation: Maintain shallow water after transplanting.
stages.monitoring: Check establishment and early weed growth.

stages.irrigation: Maintain water as per local practice.
stages.nutrients: Ask your KVK about split application timing.
stages.monitoring: Watch for stem borer, leaf folder and blast.

stages.irrigation: Moisture-sensitive stage; avoid drying.
stages.monitoring: Check for blast, sheath blight and planthoppers.

stages.irrigation: Keep water available; avoid stress.
stages.monitoring: Watch for neck blast, false smut and bugs.

stages.irrigation: Drain as per local practice before harvest.
stages.monitoring: Check grain colour and moisture before cutting.

activities: Check stand and gap fill early
stages.irrigation: Keep soil moisture adequate; avoid waterlogging.
stages.monitoring: Look for seedling wilt and soil-borne problems.

activities: Pruning or nipping if recommended locally
stages.irrigation: Mostly rainfed; irrigate only if a long dry spell and advised.
stages.monitoring: Watch for wilt, sterility mosaic and leaf-feeding insects.

stages.irrigation: Avoid moisture stress at flowering.
stages.monitoring: Watch for pod borer and flower damage.

stages.irrigation: Keep moisture even if irrigation is available.
stages.monitoring: Check for pod borer and pod fly.

stages.irrigation: Stop irrigation near maturity.
stages.monitoring: Check pod colour and dryness.
